output.subject: We've received your message about the SP * LUXEWATCHOUTLET charge
output.body:
Dear ⟦CUSTOMER_NAME_1⟧,

Thank you for writing to us, and for letting us know so quickly. We can hear how worrying this is, and we're sorry for the stress it has caused you.

We have received your complaint. You told us that when you checked your account, you saw a debit card charge of $312.45 from SP * LUXEWATCHOUTLET, and that you did not buy anything from that merchant. You mentioned you're worried someone may have access to your account, and that you have already locked your card in the app. You've asked us to fix the charge and to tell you whether anyone else has been in your account. You also let us know that if this isn't resolved, you intend to close all of your accounts with us.

A specialist team is reviewing your complaint, and we will respond to you within 10 business days.

Kind regards,
Customer Care, Meridian Harbor Bank
notes_for_analyst: Customer reports an unrecognized $312.45 debit card charge from SP * LUXEWATCHOUTLET and says they did not make it.
Customer is anxious about possible account compromise; consider whether faster contact than the 10-business-day reply is appropriate.
Decide what, if anything, to tell the customer now about protecting the account or card beyond the lock they already applied.
Decide whether to add guidance on how the customer should report any further unrecognized activity; the draft currently gives none.
Customer requested reversal of the charge; draft acknowledges the request only and makes no commitment.
Customer asked whether someone else accessed the account; draft does not answer, confirm or deny.
Customer threatened to close all accounts; consider retention or relationship follow-up.
Confirm whether there are other unrecognized transactions before sending.
